# The sea: a plane 9 m wide from 7 m in front of the run to 8 m behind it, 0.3 m under the ice top.
# It travels with the camera (the game snaps it to the art grid). Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Water --base-color 0.118 0.376 0.431 --no-slot
add mesh plane --name Sea --size 1 --location 0 0.5 -0.3
scale 9 15 1
apply --scale
material assign Water
shade flat
export water.glb
